verdict.rationale: Plausible offers a read-only Stats API (/api/v2/query) for pulling metrics, but there is no evidence of an MCP server, nor any API for programmatically constructing or configuring a custom dashboard — Plausible's dashboard is a fixed built-in UI, not a buildable/composable object exposed via API. Probes for llms.txt/docs.md/openapi all 404, reinforcing the lack of an agent-friendly interface for this workflow.
